description: Adversarial: deliberate drift between causal_edges.source_references and edge_source_refs to verify the drift detector reports >0.

preconditions.comment: Clean edge has 1 JSONB ref + 1 index row. Drift edge has 1 JSONB ref + 0 index rows.

assertions.because: Exactly one JSONB ref has no corresponding edge_source_refs row — the deliberately-omitted drift edge ref.

assertions.comment: findEdgesCitingReference reads through edge_source_refs only; querying for the drifted ref returns [] even though the JSONB cites it. This is the failure mode the drift detector exists to surface.
